summary: Stewards, Inc. reported that its wholly owned subsidiary Stewards Real Estate, LLC terminated a June 5, 2026 Purchase and Sale Agreement with John E. Swenson Co., Inc. to acquire The Hawthorne, 196 Shore Road, Chatham, Massachusetts, for $20,000,000 cash. A dispute over the $1,000,000 earnest-money deposit led to Massachusetts Superior Court litigation. Under a September 17, 2026 confidential settlement, escrow returns $900,000 to Stewards and pays $100,000 to Swenson; Swenson must dismiss the action with prejudice within three business days of distribution, after which mutual releases become effective. Watch settlement mechanics and any disclosure of the undisclosed agreement.
